sentences.en: While we see and care about many of the same problems, I know we often come to different conclusions about how to best address them.
sentences.zh: 虽然我们看到并关心许多相同的问题，但我知道我们经常就如何最好地解决这些问题得出不同的结论。

sentences.en: But what I value in you is your genuineness, curiosity, kindness, and desire to make a difference.
sentences.zh: 但我看重你的是你的真诚、好奇心、善良以及做出改变的愿望。

sentences.en: And I consider you a great friend.

sentences.en: Love, Sophia.

sentences.zh: 现在读这些交流，你有什么感觉？

sentences.zh: 我们曾经跨越政治分歧的相互尊重关系已经完全消失了。

sentences.en: And I think it's sad for me personally, but I think it's also sad for the country.
sentences.zh: 我认为这对我个人来说很遗憾，但我也觉得这对国家来说很遗憾。

sentences.en: Why sad for you personally?
sentences.zh: 为什么对你个人来说很遗憾？

sentences.en: And that's disappointing to see anyone do, obviously.

sentences.zh: 很少有人能比万斯在法学院的朋友更近距离地见证这种变化，

sentences.en: Over the past week, Nelson has decided to speak out against Vance, a decision that began when she gave The Times a trove of personal correspondence with Vance
sentences.zh: 在过去的一周里，纳尔逊决定公开反对万斯，这个决定始于她向《时报》提供了一批她与万斯长达多年友谊中的

sentences.en: from their years-long friendship.
sentences.zh: 个人往来书信。

sentences.en: Today, I speak with Nelson about what exactly she's doing, why she decided to do it, and what she's learned about who J.D.
sentences.zh: 今天，我与纳尔逊对话，探讨她到底在做什么，她为什么决定这样做，以及她对 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance really is.
sentences.zh: 万斯究竟是怎样的人有了什么新的认识。

sentences.en: It's Monday, August 5th.
sentences.zh: 今天是8月5日，星期一。

sentences.en: So, I want to better understand the story of what happened to your relationship with J.D.
sentences.zh: 所以，我想更好地了解你与 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance and what ultimately led you over the past few weeks to share a lot of your personal emails and messages that you exchanged with Vance with The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 万斯的关系到底发生了什么故事，以及是什么最终促使你在过去几周里与《纽约时报》分享了许多你与万斯交换的个人电子邮件和信息。

sentences.en: But I want to start with the story of your friendship.
sentences.zh: 但我想从你们友谊的故事开始讲起。

sentences.en: When did you first meet J.D.
sentences.zh: 你是什么时候第一次见到 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance?
sentences.zh: 万斯的？

sentences.en: J.D.
sentences.zh: J.D.

sentences.en: and I met in the fall of 2010 during orientation at Yale Law School.
sentences.zh: 和我是在2010年秋天耶鲁法学院的迎新活动上认识的。

sentences.en: We were both assigned to the same small group, which is 16 individuals.
sentences.zh: 我们俩都被分到了同一个小班，也就是16个人。

sentences.en: And so we took all of our first semester courses together, and we were encouraged by the university to bond with that small group.
sentences.zh: 所以我们第一学期的所有课程都在一起上，学校鼓励我们那个小班的人要增进感情。

sentences.en: I mean, they did so much as pay for us to essentially socialize together.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们甚至出钱让我们一起进行社交活动。

sentences.en: So, we spent a great deal of time together in that first semester,
sentences.zh: 所以，我们在第一学期花了很多时间在一起，

sentences.en: and we bonded over being from the Midwest, coming from working-class communities,
sentences.zh: 我们因为都来自中西部、来自工人阶级社区、

sentences.en: going to public school K-12, which, you know, is not the norm at Yale Law School.
sentences.zh: 从幼儿园到高中都上公立学校而建立了深厚的感情，你知道的，这在耶鲁法学院并不是常态。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: There's a lot of people who go to very fancy private schools.
sentences.zh: 有很多人去的是非常高级的私立学校。

sentences.en: Yeah, most people at Yale Law School are coastal elites, and so J.D.
sentences.zh: 是的，耶鲁法学院的大多数人都是沿海精英，所以 J.D.

sentences.en: and I are not those things.
sentences.zh: 和我并非那样的人。

sentences.en: You know, J.D.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，J.D.

sentences.en: grew up in Middletown, Ohio.
sentences.zh: 在俄亥俄州米德尔敦长大。

sentences.en: I grew up in Wayland, Michigan.
sentences.zh: 我在密歇根州韦兰长大。

sentences.en: And the collapse of the auto industry in 2007, 2008 devastated my hometown.
sentences.zh: 2007、2008年汽车工业的崩溃摧毁了我的家乡。

sentences.en: And obviously, the opioid epidemic that came after that has similarly wreaked havoc.
sentences.zh: 显然，随之而来的阿片类药物流行也造成了同样的浩劫。

sentences.en: And we bonded over that.
sentences.zh: 我们因此而结下了情谊。

sentences.en: And I think we both, you know, we're a little shocked by the level of wealth and nepotism present at these elite universities.
sentences.zh: 我想我们俩，你知道的，对这些精英大学里存在的财富和裙带关系水平感到有些震惊。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: I remember he was deeply hurt by a comment that one of our professors made, that people who went to state schools tended to perform less well in the Yale Law School environment.
sentences.zh: 我记得他曾深受我们一位教授的一番评论伤害，那位教授说去州立学校的人在耶鲁法学院环境中的表现往往不那么好。

sentences.en: Because he had gone to a state school.
sentences.zh: 因为他曾就读于一所州立学校。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He had gone to Ohio State, and my reaction was,
sentences.zh: 他上过俄亥俄州立大学，我的反应是，

sentences.en: J.D., this man is so out of touch.
sentences.zh: J.D.，这个人太脱离现实了。

sentences.en: Don't listen to anything he has to say.
sentences.zh: 别听他胡说八道。

sentences.en: Obviously, there's no monopoly on intelligence by the Ivy Leagues.
sentences.zh: 显然，常春藤盟校对智力没有垄断权。

sentences.en: Do you remember what he said in response when you tried to console him?
sentences.zh: 你还记得当你试图安慰他时他是怎么回答的吗？

sentences.en: I think he was hell-bent on proving them wrong, which was totally within his right.
sentences.zh: 我想他铁了心要证明他们是错的，这完全是他的权利。

sentences.en: And I think he was very successful at that.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为他在这方面非常成功。

sentences.en: What was his personality in this place?
sentences.zh: 他在那个地方的性格是怎样的？

sentences.en: Just give us a sense of him.
sentences.zh: 给我们讲讲他的感觉吧。

sentences.en: I mean, the J.D.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我与之交朋友的 J.D.

sentences.en: that I became friends with was sarcastic, incredibly curious, motivated.
sentences.zh: 尖酸刻薄、极具好奇心且充满动力。

sentences.en: And he loved talking with everyone he could get his hands on about political philosophy and the political issues of our time.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢和任何他能接触到的人谈论政治哲学和我们时代的政治问题。

sentences.en: And I loved doing the same thing.
sentences.zh: 我也喜欢做同样的事情。

sentences.en: I thought J.D.
sentences.zh: 我以为 J.D.

sentences.en: and I shared a curiosity and a commitment to talking across difference and a desire to solve real probleMs.
sentences.zh: 和我有着同样的好奇心、致力于跨越分歧对话以及解决真实问题的愿望。

sentences.en: You know, my parents and my friends from home were so surprised that, oh, this person that you've connected with is on the opposite end of the political spectrum from you.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我父母和家乡的朋友都非常惊讶，哦，你结识的这个人竟然在政治光谱的对立面上。

sentences.en: And I was like, yeah, but culturally, we're very similar.
sentences.zh: 而我说，对啊，但在文化上我们非常相似。

sentences.en: And how would you describe his political views at the time?
sentences.zh: 你会如何形容他当时的政治观点？

sentences.en: Where was he then on the ideological continuum?
sentences.zh: 他当时在意识形态光谱的什么位置？

sentences.en: I mean, he was a bit of an iconoclast, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他有点像个打破常规的人，对吧？

sentences.en: He wasn't necessarily beholden to a specific ideology at the time.
sentences.zh: 他当时不一定受制于某种特定的意识形态。

sentences.en: I thought he was somewhat creative in his thinking.
sentences.zh: 我认为他的思维颇具创造性。

sentences.en: He was a voracious reader.
sentences.zh: 他是一个博览群书的人。

sentences.en: He was a conservative who was disillusioned with the culture wars and thought that they were destructive and a distraction.
sentences.zh: 他是一个对文化战争感到幻灭的保守派，认为文化战争具有破坏性且只会转移注意力。

sentences.en: It's interesting that you said he's disillusioned with the culture wars.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是你说他对文化战争感到幻灭。

sentences.en: And just to make sure I understand that, he just doesn't think there's much point in having long battles about questions of, you know, sexuality or identity.
sentences.zh: 为了确保我理解得没错，他只是觉得花长时间去争论诸如性取向或身份认同之类的问题没有什么意义。

sentences.en: That just didn't feel useful to him.
sentences.zh: 那对他来说毫无用处。

sentences.en: That was my belief at the time.
sentences.zh: 这是我当时的看法。

sentences.en: And, you know, he certainly had a diverse group of friends.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，他的确有一群各式各样的朋友。

sentences.en: I think he was skeptical of the identity politics of the left.
sentences.zh: 我想他对左翼的身份政治持怀疑态度。

sentences.en: And he just didn't understand why that needed to be a main topic of conversation.
sentences.zh: 他只是不明白为什么这需要成为对话的核心话题。

sentences.en: Because why can't we just get to know a person for who they are?
sentences.zh: 因为为什么我们不能单单通过一个人本身的为人来了解他呢？

sentences.en: And, Sophia, how did you identify at the time during this period of law school?
sentences.zh: 索菲亚，在法学院这段时期，你当时的身份认同是什么？

sentences.en: He called you a progressive lesbian in his book, which I take it from his wording is not quite accurate.
sentences.zh: 他在书里称你为进步的女同性恋，从他的用词来看，我觉得这并不太准确。

sentences.en: Yeah, I certainly identified as a progressive and still do.
sentences.zh: 是的，我当时当然认为自己是个进步派，现在也是。

sentences.en: However, lesbian was not the word that I would have used to describe myself at the time, nor do I use that word now.
sentences.zh: 然而，“女同性恋”并不是我当时用来形容自己的词，我现在也不用这个词。

sentences.en: And I have a trans identity and a queer identity.
sentences.zh: 我有着跨性别身份和酷儿身份。

sentences.en: Labels are not that important to me, and I wasn't offended when he called me a lesbian.
sentences.zh: 标签对我来说没那么重要，当他叫我女同性恋时我并没有被冒犯。

sentences.en: And I wouldn't be offended if someone called me a lesbian today.
sentences.zh: 如果今天有人叫我女同性恋，我也不会被冒犯。

sentences.en: As long as people are well-intentioned, the language that they use is not going to set me off.
sentences.zh: 只要人们出于善意，他们使用的语言就不会把我惹恼。

sentences.en: Well, given that, I'm curious how he felt about you and your identity in this period.
sentences.zh: 鉴于此，我很好奇在这段时期他对你和你的身份作何感想。

sentences.en: Was that ever tense or in any way awkward?
sentences.zh: 这曾经带来过紧张或任何尴尬吗？

sentences.en: Did his politics ever become in conflict with who you were?
sentences.zh: 他的政治立场是否曾与你的本真身份发生冲突？

sentences.en: Absolutely not.
sentences.zh: 绝对没有。

sentences.en: You know, my partner at the time was a woman.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我当时的伴侣是一位女性。

sentences.en: And we were invited to their wedding, and we went together.
sentences.zh: 我们收到了他们婚礼的邀请，然后一起去了。

sentences.en: To the wedding of J.D.
sentences.zh: 去参加 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance and his now wife.
sentences.zh: 万斯和他现在的妻子的婚礼。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And when we spoke, even after law school, he would ask me how she was doing.
sentences.zh: 当我们交谈时，甚至在法学院毕业后，他还会问我她过得怎么样。

sentences.en: He showed interest in, you know, cared about my relationship and my well-being, and I cared about his.
sentences.zh: 他表现出兴趣，你知道的，关心我的恋爱关系和我的幸福，我也关心他的。

sentences.en: And, you know, Usha was also in our small group.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，乌莎也在我们的小班里。

sentences.en: His wife.
sentences.zh: 他的妻子。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I don't think it even crossed their mind to care if someone was gay or trans, or you just get to know people for who they are.
sentences.zh: 我想他们根本不会去在意别人是不是同性恋或跨性别者，你只需要通过一个人的本来面目去了解他们就行了。

sentences.en: And I had gender-affirming surgery in 2012 while I was in law school.
sentences.zh: 我在2012年法学院期间做过性别重置手术。

sentences.en: And my partner at the time emailed my closest friends, letting them know that that's what I was doing.
sentences.zh: 我当时的伴侣给我的好朋友们发了电子邮件，让他们知道我在做这件事。

sentences.en: And that, you know, when I came back to school, it would be really nice if, you know, they supported me in my recovery.
sentences.zh: 并且，你知道的，当我回到学校时，如果大家能在我的康复期间支持我，那就太好了。

sentences.en: And that was very sweet of her to do that.
sentences.zh: 她这么做真的很贴心。

sentences.en: And I remember him bringing me baked goods, and we had a brief conversation that was essentially like,
sentences.zh: 我记得他给我带了烘焙食品，我们进行了一次简短的交谈，基本上就是：

sentences.en: I don't really know what top surgery is or why you did that, but, you know, whatever you need to do to be happy, like, I support you, essentially.
sentences.zh: 我其实不知道什么是胸部手术，也不知道你为什么要这么做，但不管你需要做什么才能快乐，我都支持你，基本上就是这样。

sentences.en: And it meant a lot to me because, you know, I obviously had a lot of, or maybe it's not obvious,
sentences.zh: 这对我意义重大，因为，你知道的，我显然有很多，或者可能这并不明显，

sentences.en: but I had a lot of queer friends in law school, and I didn't need to do a lot of explaining about why I was getting surgery to them.
sentences.zh: 但我在法学院有很多酷儿朋友，我不需要向他们解释我为什么要去做手术。

sentences.en: And J.D.
sentences.zh: 而且 J.D.

sentences.en: wasn't asking me to explain either.
sentences.zh: 也没有要求我解释。

sentences.en: I don't need anyone to understand, you know, why I needed to get surgery or exactly the complexity of my identities if they can treat me with respect and kindness.
sentences.zh: 如果别人能以尊重和善良对待我，我不需要任何人去理解我为什么需要做手术，也不需要他们理解我身份的复杂性。

sentences.en: So, you and J.D.
sentences.zh: 所以，你和J.D.

sentences.en: Vance both graduate from Yale Law School.
sentences.zh: 万斯都毕业于耶鲁法学院。

sentences.en: You both leave New Haven.
sentences.zh: 你们俩都离开了纽黑文。

sentences.en: You become this public defender in Detroit.
sentences.zh: 你成了底特律的一名公设辩护律师。

sentences.en: He goes off to a law firm.
sentences.zh: 他去了一家律师事务所。

sentences.en: Did you think that you would stay close and keep in touch?
sentences.zh: 你们当时觉得彼此还会走得很近、保持联系吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I did.
sentences.zh: 是的，我当时觉得会。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: He challenged me intellectually, and I felt like we both benefited from discussing current events and ideas, knowing that we wouldn't usually agree.
sentences.zh: 他在思想上给我带来了挑战，我觉得我们都从讨论时事和观点中受益匪浅，而且我们知道彼此通常意见不一。

sentences.en: I really thought J.D.
sentences.zh: 我真的觉得J.D.

sentences.en: helped me think carefully about the issues that I was seeing in my work, and I was hopeful that I was doing the same for him.
sentences.zh: 帮我深入思考了我在工作中看到的那些问题，我也希望自己对他有所帮助。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: You were making each other smarter and sharper.
sentences.zh: 你们让彼此变得更聪明、更敏锐了。

sentences.en: I want to talk about that because I've now looked at this correspondence that you shared with the Times that occurs after law school.
sentences.zh: 我想聊聊这个，因为我最近看过了你和《纽约时报》分享的你们在法学院毕业后的通信。

sentences.en: And you two very much become adult pen pals, right?
sentences.zh: 你们俩非常像成年的笔友，对吧？

sentences.en: You're kind of processing everything in the world.
sentences.zh: 你们俩基本上在探讨世间万物。

sentences.en: Some of the most divisive subjects of our time, you talk about race, policing, affirmative action, and as makes sense given what we've talked about here,
sentences.zh: 你们谈论的是我们这个时代最具分裂性的主题——种族、警务、平权行动，正如我们在这里讨论过的那样，这一切都顺理成章：

sentences.en: you come at them from different perspectives, but you're both trying to find a lot of common ground, and you often do.
sentences.zh: 你们从不同的视角切入，但你们都在努力寻找许多共同点，而且你们经常能找到。

sentences.en: And I'm curious, what do you remember most from those exchanges?
sentences.zh: 我很好奇，在那些交流中，你记忆最深的是什么？

sentences.en: What stands out to you from them?
sentences.zh: 有什么让你印象深刻的内容？

sentences.en: It gave me hope, because at the time, our politics was starting to shift nationally away from any desire to build consensus.
sentences.zh: 这给了我希望，因为当时我们的国家政治正开始偏离任何建立共识的愿望。

sentences.en: His thoughtfulness and our relationship gave me hope that that wasn't a lost cause.
sentences.zh: 他的深思熟虑和我们的关系让我看到，那种愿望并不是无可救药。

sentences.en: Do you mind if I engage with some of the specific things he said in those emails?
sentences.zh: 你介意我引用一些他在那些电子邮件中说过的具体内容吗？

sentences.en: Because I think it will help listeners get a feel for what he's saying and better understand your reactions to them.
sentences.zh: 因为我觉得这能让听众感受一下他的言论，并更好地理解你对这些言论的反应。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Let me start with the post-Michael Brown exchanges that you guys are having.
sentences.zh: 那我们就从迈克尔·布朗事件后你们的交流开始吧。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Vance writes to you that he thinks it's important that there be greater accountability for police officers.
sentences.zh: 万斯写信给你，说他认为追究警方的更大责任非常重要。

sentences.en: And he writes, quote, I love the body camera movement and anything that puts cops back in the mindset of service and protection instead of control and coercion.
sentences.zh: 他写道：“我喜欢随身摄像机运动，喜欢任何能让警察重新抱持服务与保护理念，而不是控制与强迫心态的事物。”

sentences.en: And he goes on to say,
sentences.zh: 他接着说道：

sentences.en: I hate the police.
sentences.zh: “我讨厌警察。

sentences.en: Given the number of negative experiences I've had in the past few years, I can't imagine what a black guy goes through.
sentences.zh: 考虑到过去几年我经历过的那些负面遭遇，我简直无法想象一个黑人要经历什么。”

sentences.en: And then he talks to you about the subject of that horrible mass shooting in Charleston.
sentences.zh: 然后他跟你聊到了查尔斯顿那起可怕的大规模枪击案。

sentences.en: And he expresses bewilderment that anyone would ever try to disentangle the presence of the Confederate flag over the South Carolina Statehouse from what happened in that shooting.
sentences.zh: 他对居然有人试图把南卡罗来纳州议会大厦上飘扬的邦联旗帜与那场枪击案撇清关系感到不可思议。

sentences.en: And he talks to you about reparations for black Americans.
sentences.zh: 他还跟你谈到了针对美国黑人的赔偿问题。

sentences.en: And he says, quote, I will say this.
sentences.zh: 他写道：“我要说的是：

sentences.en: Whatever practical or moral problems I have with compensating the ancestors of slaves or compensating, quote, black people as a giant collective,
sentences.zh: 无论我对补偿奴隶的祖先或补偿所谓的‘庞大集体黑人群体’抱有什么实际或道德上的问题，

sentences.en: I have at least been convinced of the virtue of compensating modern victims who suffered from redlining or denial of federal benefits or something similar.
sentences.zh: 我至少已经认识到了补偿那些遭受过划红线政策、被剥夺联邦福利或类似遭遇的现代受害者的价值。”

sentences.en: It makes sense to me, he tells you, that black veterans who never got their GI bill benefits are owed something.
sentences.zh: 他告诉你，他觉得那些从未拿到《退伍军人权利法案》福利的黑人老兵确实应该得到一些补偿。

sentences.en: I mean, these are very moderate, highly nuanced, compassionate viewpoints.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这些是非常温和、高度细致且富有同情心的观点。

sentences.en: Completely.
sentences.zh: 完全如此。

sentences.en: And I remember responding specifically to the reparations discussion because I had sent him Ta-Nehisi Coates' piece in The Atlantic.
sentences.zh: 我记得我专门针对赔偿的讨论作出了回应，因为我曾把塔那那西·科茨在《大西洋月刊》上发表的文章发给他。

sentences.en: And that was what launched this conversation.
sentences.zh: 这就是这场对话的导火索。

sentences.en: I responded something along the lines of, I think that's really big.
sentences.zh: 我的回复大致意思是，我觉得这格局真的很大。

sentences.en: If you, conservative J.D.
sentences.zh: 如果你，保守派J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, now see that the government has taken action to, in modern times, widen the wealth gap between white and black Americans through policy,
sentences.zh: 万斯，现在也看清了政府在现代通过政策拉大了白人和黑人美国人之间的财富差距，

sentences.en: and that the government needs to take action to remedy that.
sentences.zh: 并且政府需要采取行动来纠正这一点。

sentences.en: And he was like, well, it shouldn't be.
sentences.zh: 而他的态度则是，嗯，其实不应该这样。

sentences.en: I want to talk specifically about Donald Trump because one thing that really stands out in your emails with J.D.
sentences.zh: 我想具体谈谈唐纳德·特朗普，因为在回顾你和J.D.

sentences.en: Vance is how much you two agree on Donald Trump as he emerges onto the political scene.
sentences.zh: 万斯的邮件时，有一个非常突出的细节，那就是当特朗普登上政治舞台时，你们两个人在特朗普的问题上是多么高度一致。

sentences.en: How did he represent his feelings about Trump in that period?
sentences.zh: 在那段时期，他是如何表达自己对特朗普的看法的？

sentences.en: The public record on this is extensive, and it's no different from what he said to me personally, which is a recognition that Trump was flanning the flames of racism.
sentences.zh: 这方面的公开记录非常多，而且这和他在私下对我说的话没什么两样，那就是他认为特朗普在煽动种族主义的火焰。

sentences.en: And he was very concerned about the effect of that rhetoric on people's sense of feeling included in their country and their own personal safety.
sentences.zh: 他非常担心这种言论对人们在国家归属感以及他们个人安全感方面所产生的影响。

sentences.en: And that came up, and, you know, I live in Detroit.
sentences.zh: 这事当时提起过，你知道的，我住在底特律。

sentences.en: Metro Detroit houses the largest Muslim population in the United States.
sentences.zh: 大底特律地区是全美穆斯林人口最多的地方。

sentences.en: And one of my friends at the time told me that some of the women in her life that wear hijab were feeling as harassed and scared around Trump's rhetoric,
sentences.zh: 我当时的一位朋友告诉我，她身边有些戴头巾的女性，在特朗普的言论风波下，感到了一种骚扰和恐惧，

sentences.en: doing basic things like going to the grocery store, as they had felt in the wake of 9-11.
sentences.zh: 就像她们在“9·11”之后感受到的一样，甚至连去杂货店买东西这样最基本的事情都觉得害怕。

sentences.en: And you told him that?
sentences.zh: 你把这个告诉他了？

sentences.en: I did.
sentences.zh: 我告诉他了。

sentences.en: And he responded with empathy and concern.
sentences.zh: 他对此作出了充满同理心和关切的回应。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: In his emails to you, he's pretty unambiguous in his disgust for Trump in this period.
sentences.zh: 在他给你的邮件中，他在这一时期对特朗普的厌恶是毫无歧义的。

sentences.en: I mean, he writes to you that Trump is a disaster.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他写信给你说特朗普是一场灾难。

sentences.en: He actually says a effing disaster.
sentences.zh: 他甚至用了“他妈的灾难”这样的词。

sentences.en: He calls him a bad man and, quote, a morally reprehensible human being.
sentences.zh: 他称他为坏人，并称其为“道德上应受谴责的人”。

sentences.en: What did you think about that?
sentences.zh: 你当时是怎么想的？

sentences.en: I thought it reflected his core values.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这反映了他的核心价值观。

sentences.en: While we differed on tax policy and how big or small government should be, we agreed that nobody should be vilified and dehumanized.
sentences.zh: 尽管我们在税收政策以及政府应该管得宽还是管得严的问题上有分歧，但我们一致认为，任何人都不应被妖魔化和非人化。

sentences.en: And that talking about Americans or non-Americans in callous and cruel terms was amoral, right?
sentences.zh: 以冷酷残忍的言辞谈论美国人或非美国人是不道德的，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, I don't know Donald Trump, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我并不认识唐纳德·特朗普，对吧？

sentences.en: I'm sure he has things I could find to love about him if I was his family member or friend.
sentences.zh: 我敢肯定，如果我是他的家人或朋友，我也会发现他身上有可爱之处。

sentences.en: But the moral injury that his rhetoric has wracked on this country is devastating.
sentences.zh: 但他的言论对这个国家造成的道德伤害是毁灭性的。

sentences.en: And J.D.
sentences.zh: 当时J.D.

sentences.en: and I agreed on that at the time.
sentences.zh: 和我在这点上达成了一致。

sentences.en: I mean, we shared a belief that what Donald Trump was trying to do was morally reprehensible and dangerous.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们共同坚信，唐纳德·特朗普企图做的事是道德上应受谴责且危险的。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wynna Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜·刘。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》游戏板块字谜游戏“连连看”的作者。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我也喜欢试图套路你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基。

sentences.en: And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我每天负责创作“拼字蜜蜂”和“方块连字”游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有种叫做联觉的奇妙体验。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏正是由你刚才听到的这些人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 请访问 nytimes.com/games，今天就开始游玩吧。

sentences.en: So after Trump was elected, was there a point where you noticed that the kinds of conversations that you had been having with J.D.
sentences.zh: 所以在特朗普当选之后，你有没有注意到，你和J.D.

sentences.en: Vance
sentences.zh: 万斯

sentences.en: and the J.D.
sentences.zh: 曾经有过的那些对话，

sentences.en: Vance you were starting to see out in the world were diverging?
sentences.zh: 与你开始在世人面前看到的那个J.D.万斯，两者之间出现了分歧？

sentences.en: It wasn't until 2020.
sentences.zh: 直到2020年才出现这种情况。

sentences.en: His tone on Twitter started changing.
sentences.zh: 他在推特上的语气开始变了。

sentences.en: How so?
sentences.zh: 怎么个变法？

sentences.en: He started name-calling.
sentences.zh: 他开始骂人了。

sentences.en: He started adopting Donald Trump's style of speak.
sentences.zh: 他开始采用唐纳德·特朗普的说话风格了。

sentences.en: And it's just not at all reflective of the person I had gotten to know.
sentences.zh: 这跟我所了解的那个人简直判若两人。

sentences.en: And it was concerning.
sentences.zh: 这让人担忧。

sentences.en: And do you remember specifically the names he called?
sentences.zh: 你还记得他具体骂了些什么吗？

sentences.en: Well, I certainly remember the childless cat lady comments.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我当然记得关于“不生孩子的养猫女人”的那些言论。

sentences.en: A bunch of childless cat ladies who are miserable at their own lives and the choices that they've made.
sentences.zh: “一堆不生孩子的养猫女人，她们对自己的生活和做出的选择感到痛苦，

sentences.en: And so they want to make the rest of the country miserable, too.
sentences.zh: 所以她们也想让全国其他人一样痛苦。”

sentences.en: And the idea that people who don't have children don't have a meaningful stake in the country.
sentences.zh: 还有那种观点，认为没有孩子的人在这个国家没有切身利益。

sentences.en: When you go to the polls in this country as a parent, you should have more power.
sentences.zh: “作为一个父母，当你在国内参加投票时，你应该拥有更大的权力。

sentences.en: You shouldn't have the same voting rights as people with children.
sentences.zh: 你不应该和有孩子的享有同等的投票权。

sentences.en: If you don't have as much of an investment in the future of this country, maybe you shouldn't get nearly the same voice.
sentences.zh: 如果你对这个国家的未来没有那么多的投入，也许你就不应该拥有几乎同等的发言权。”

sentences.en: And then he started making really cruel comments about abortion.
sentences.zh: 接着，他开始就堕胎问题发表极其残忍的言论。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, I certainly would like abortion to be illegal nationally.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，我当然希望堕胎在全国范围内都是非法的。

sentences.en: He came out opposing abortion in cases of rape and inceSt.
sentences.zh: 他公开反对在强奸和乱伦情况下的堕胎。

sentences.en: And when we talked about abortion in law school, J.D.
sentences.zh: 而在法学院讨论堕胎问题时，J.D.

sentences.en: was deeply uncomfortable with the concept of abortion.
sentences.zh: 对堕胎的概念感到深深的不安。

sentences.en: What he relayed to me is what his grandmother had taught him, which is that you can never know what situation a woman is in when she's making that difficult decision.
sentences.zh: 他向我转述的是他外祖母教给他的人生道理，那就是你永远无法知道一个女人在做出那个艰难决定时身处何种境地。

sentences.en: And it's not the government's business, essentially.
sentences.zh: 从根本上说，这不关政府的事。

sentences.en: And I think he was really struggling with whether he agreed with his grandmother or not.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他当时真的很纠结，不知道自己是否同意他外祖母的观点。

sentences.en: But his extreme opinions started developing in 2020.
sentences.zh: 但他的极端口号是在2020年开始萌芽的。

sentences.en: And when he came out in support of a ban on gender affirming care in 2021 that was introduced in Arkansas, I reached out to him directly.
sentences.zh: 当他在2021年公开支持阿肯色州出台的禁止性别肯定医疗护理的法案时，我直接联系了他。

sentences.en: When someone is trying to strip you of your political and civil rights and you have their cell phone number, at least I felt like I needed to text him about it, and I did.
sentences.zh: 当有人试图剥夺你的政治和公民权利，而你又有他们的手机号码时，至少我觉得我需要给他发短信谈谈这事，于是我照做了。

sentences.en: And what did you say to him?
sentences.zh: 你对他说什么了？

sentences.en: I asked him if he supported these laws.
sentences.zh: 我问他是否支持这些法律。

sentences.en: These are bans on gender affirming care for children, specifically the Arkansas bill.
sentences.zh: 这些是针对儿童性别肯定医疗护理的禁令，尤其是阿肯色州的法案。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And we went back and forth.
sentences.zh: 我们为此进行了一番争论。

sentences.en: And he acknowledged that it was awkward, but then explained to me that he thought it was experimentation and that I had been brainwashed by Jeff Bezos.
sentences.zh: 他承认这很尴尬，但随后向我解释说，他认为这是一种实验，还说我被杰夫·贝佐斯洗脑了。

sentences.en: And, I mean, it was just the tenor of the conversation was completely anathema to the tenor of our previous conversations.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，整个对话的基调与我们以前对话的基调完全背道而驰。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I've read this text exchange.
sentences.zh: 我看过这些短信交流。

sentences.en: And whereas almost all of your previous messages are two generous people working through tough stuff, right?
sentences.zh: 鉴于你之前几乎所有的信息都是两个慷慨大方的人在共同探讨艰难的问题，对吧？

sentences.en: This one feels like that dynamic is kind of unraveling.
sentences.zh: 而这一次，这种默契似乎正在瓦解。

sentences.en: And you say to him at one point in this exchange, quote, the political voice you have become seems so, so far from the man I got to know in law school.
sentences.zh: 在这场对话的某个时刻，你对他说：“你现在变成的这个政治代言人，看起来离我在法学院认识的那个人实在是太远太远了。”

sentences.en: And J.D.
sentences.zh: 而J.D.

sentences.en: Vance replies to you, I will always love you, but I really do think the left's cultural progressivism is making it harder for normal people to live their lives.
sentences.zh: 万斯回复你：“我永远爱你，但我真的认为左翼的文化进步主义正在让正常人更难维持日常生活。”

sentences.en: And that back and forth feels like it marks a change in your relationship.
sentences.zh: 这种来回交锋感觉像是标志着你们关系的转变。

sentences.en: It was incredibly different, and it was incredibly painful and hurtful.
sentences.zh: 这简直判若两人，而且令人无比痛苦、深感受伤。

sentences.en: This division of Americans that he has embraced of normal people and everyone else.
sentences.zh: 他所接受的那种将美国人划分为正常人和其他所有人的对立。

sentences.en: I am a normal person.
sentences.zh: 我就是一个正常人。

sentences.en: Queer people are normal Americans.
sentences.zh: 酷儿群体也是正常的美国人。

sentences.en: I don't, whatever, I don't divide the world between normal and abnormal people.
sentences.zh: 我才不会，不管怎样，我不会把世界划分为正常人和不正常的人。

sentences.en: I don't think that helps anyone.
sentences.zh: 我不认为这对任何人有帮助。

sentences.en: And in a lot of ways, I think I lead a much more average life than he does.
sentences.zh: 而且在很多方面，我觉得我过着比他平淡得多的生活。

sentences.en: I am not a millionaire.
sentences.zh: 我不是百万富翁。

sentences.en: I lead a private existence.
sentences.zh: 我过着私密的生活。

sentences.en: And specifically the term normal really scared me.
sentences.zh: 尤其是“正常”这个词，真的把我吓坏了。

sentences.en: Because he has set up a war between, quote, normal people and those who are trying to attack them.
sentences.zh: 因为他在所谓的“正常人”和那些试图攻击他们的人之间挑起了战争。

sentences.en: You know, I shared some pretty personal stuff with him about my experience as a trans kid.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我曾跟他分享过一些非常私人的事情，关于我作为跨性别儿童的经历。

sentences.en: Because I know what it's like to sit and cry as a kid and think, I have to fix myself.
sentences.zh: 因为我懂得作为一个孩子坐在那儿哭泣、心想“我必须纠正自己，我绝不可能以这种身份被爱、拥有一份工作、被社会接纳并安然无恙”是什么滋味。

sentences.en: There's no way that I can be this person and be loved and have a job and be accepted and be okay.
sentences.zh: 因为我懂得作为一个孩子坐在那儿哭泣、心想“我必须纠正自己，我绝不可能以这种身份被爱、拥有一份工作、被社会接纳并安然无恙”是什么滋味。

sentences.en: And that is a devastating experience.
sentences.zh: 那是一段毁灭性的经历。

sentences.en: And I was so hopeful that it would be easier for future generations.
sentences.zh: 我曾无比希望未来的几代人能过得更容易些。

sentences.en: And what I was seeing JD engage in is something that was even scarier than what I grew up with.
sentences.zh: 而我看到J.D.参与的事情，甚至比我当年成长时经历的还要让人恐惧。

sentences.en: And so I felt personally betrayed, but also very fearful.
sentences.zh: 所以我既感到个人遭到背叛，也感到非常恐惧。

sentences.en: And the hope that I was talking about before that our correspondence gave me sunk.
sentences.zh: 而我之前所说的、我们的通信曾经带给我的希望也破灭了。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Could you believe that you were having that conversation?
sentences.zh: 你能相信当时你在进行那样的对话吗？

sentences.en: I believe that the man that I used to know was gone.
sentences.zh: 我相信我曾经认识的那个人已经不在了。

sentences.en: So, of course, what happens next is that Vance is catapulted into his political career.
sentences.zh: 所以，当然，接下来发生的事情就是万斯一跃跨入了政坛。

sentences.en: He makes peace with Trump, apologizes to Trump, embraces Trump, runs for Senate in Ohio.
sentences.zh: 他和特朗普握手言跟，向特朗普道歉，拥抱特朗普，在俄亥俄州竞选参议员。

sentences.en: Yeah, and I obviously followed what was happening in the Ohio race.
sentences.zh: 是的，我显然一直在关注俄亥俄州竞选的发展。

sentences.en: And I chose not to say anything at that time.
sentences.zh: 而我当时选择不说任何话。

sentences.en: You know, my classmate Josh McLaurin leaked a message where JD had privately referred to Donald Trump as America's Hitler.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我的同学乔什·麦克劳林泄露了一条信息，万斯在私下里把唐纳德·特朗普称为“美国的希特勒”。

sentences.en: And obviously I had similar things in my possession.
sentences.zh: 而且显然我手里也有类似的东西。

sentences.en: But I didn't feel compelled to act at that time, which maybe was a lack of moral courage on my part.
sentences.zh: 但我当时并没有觉得非做不可，这可能是我缺乏道德勇气吧。

sentences.en: Or lingering affection?
sentences.zh: 还是恋恋不舍？

sentences.en: Probably that too, yeah.
sentences.zh: 可能也是这个，对。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think they're, you know, it's still hard for me because I have a lot of fond memories about him and his wife.
sentences.zh: 对，我想他们是，你知道的，对我来说这仍然很难，因为我和他和他的妻子有很多美好的回忆。

sentences.en: And I still care about him on some level.
sentences.zh: 而且在某种程度上我依然在乎他。

sentences.en: And I didn't want to betray him.
sentences.zh: 我不想背叛他。

sentences.en: And I think maybe I still held on some hope.
sentences.zh: 我想我可能还抱有一丝希望。

sentences.en: Okay, so once he's doing this to get elected and maybe once he's in office, we'll see some moderation.
sentences.zh: 好吧，既然他这么做是为了当选，也许一旦他上台，我们会看到一些温和的举动。

sentences.en: But that obviously hasn't happened.
sentences.zh: 但显然这并没有发生。

sentences.en: If anything, he's gotten farther to the right.
sentences.zh: 如果要说有什么变化的话，那就是他变得更右了。

sentences.en: And so tonight, Mr. Chairman, I stand here humbled.
sentences.zh: 所以今晚，主席先生，我怀着谦卑的心情站在这里。

sentences.en: And I'm overwhelmed with gratitude to say I officially accept your nomination to be vice president of the United States of America.
sentences.zh: 我满怀感激地宣布，我正式接受您对美国副总统候选人的提名。

sentences.en: And every single day for the next four years, when I walk into that White House to help President Trump,
sentences.zh: 在接下来四年的每一天里，当我走进白宫协助特朗普总统时，

sentences.en: I will be doing it for you, for your family, for your future, and for this great country.
sentences.zh: 我都是为了你们、为了你们的家庭、为了你们的未来，为了这个伟大的国家。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你们。

sentences.en: God bless all of you.
sentences.zh: 上帝保佑你们所有人。

sentences.en: And God bless our great country.
sentences.zh: 愿上帝保佑我们伟大的国家。

sentences.en: I want to talk about what it means for Vance to become Trump's running mate.
sentences.zh: 我想谈谈万斯成为特朗普竞选搭档意味着什么。

sentences.en: Because in talking to you about the emails you guys exchanged in those years after law school,
sentences.zh: 因为同你谈到法学院毕业后那几年你们交流的电子邮件时，

sentences.en: it's hard not to recognize the ways in which being Trump's running mate means that he's aligning himself with positions that are very much at odds with what he said to you in some of those emails.
sentences.zh: 我们很难不注意到，成为特朗普的竞选搭档意味着他正在与那些与他当年在邮件中对你所说的话大相径庭的立场保持一致。

sentences.en: I mean, Trump is someone who tolerates zero questioning of the police.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，特朗普是一个对警方不容许任何质疑的人。

sentences.en: Trump is someone who says that the Confederate flag is a proud symbol of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 特朗普是一个声称邦联旗是美国骄傲象征的人。

sentences.en: That's so different from the way J.D.
sentences.zh: 这和JD

sentences.en: Vance talked to you about the Confederate flag in Charleston, so different from what he said to you about hating the police and being skeptical of them.
sentences.zh: 万斯在查尔斯顿跟你谈论邦联旗时的样子大不相同，和他说他痛恨警察、对警察持怀疑态度时也大不相同。

sentences.en: And it goes on and on, the divergences.
sentences.zh: 这样的分歧还有很多很多。

sentences.en: And so it's once Vance becomes Trump's running mate that you do start to entertain the idea that these correspondents should become public.
sentences.zh: 所以，正是在万斯成为特朗普的竞选搭档之后，你才开始萌生把这些信件公之于众的想法。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: People started reaching out to me saying that reporters were calling them, this was before he was announced,
sentences.zh: 人们开始联系我，说记者在打电话找他们，这发生在他被宣布之前，

sentences.en: and that they had shared my name with reporters as someone who might have some information.
sentences.zh: 他们把我的名字告诉了记者，说我可能掌握一些信息。

sentences.en: And I kind of took the approach of, well, if a reporter calls me, I'll cross that bridge when I come to it.
sentences.zh: 我的态度差不多是，好吧，如果有记者打电话给我，到时候再说吧。

sentences.en: And eventually a reporter did call me.
sentences.zh: 最终确实有记者打电话给我了。

sentences.en: My colleague, Stephanie Saul.
sentences.zh: 我的同事，斯蒂芬妮·索尔。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I had a great deal of back and forth with Stephanie.
sentences.zh: 我和斯蒂芬妮进行了大量的沟通。

sentences.en: I talked with my partner.
sentences.zh: 我和我的伴侣谈过。

sentences.en: I talked with my parents.
sentences.zh: 我和我父母谈过。

sentences.en: And then I called a close friend from elementary school who's an independent voter, someone who I have an immense amount of respect for.
sentences.zh: 然后我给小学时的一个密友打了个电话，她是个独立选民，一个我非常尊敬的人。

sentences.en: A single mom living in rural America trying to do her beSt.
sentences.zh: 一个住在美国乡村、努力过好日子的单亲妈妈。

sentences.en: And I wanted her opinion.
sentences.zh: 我想听听她的意见。

sentences.en: And what'd she say?
sentences.zh: 她说了什么？

sentences.en: She said that she votes for people based on their character.
sentences.zh: 她说她根据人品来投票。

sentences.en: And that she thinks that this was important information.
sentences.zh: 她认为这是重要的信息。

sentences.en: But she also understood why I was really hesitant to share it.
sentences.zh: 但她也理解为什么我真的很犹豫要不要分享。

sentences.en: But ultimately that she thought that was important information was really crucial in my decision.
sentences.zh: 但最终她认为这是重要信息，这对我的决定起到了至关重要的作用。

sentences.en: I think the importance of the correspondence and why I made them public is that, you know,
sentences.zh: 我认为这些信件的重要性以及我将它们公之于众的原因在于，你知道的，

sentences.en: J.D.
sentences.zh: JD

sentences.en: has tried to explain why he changed his mind on Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 一直试图解释他为什么改变了对唐纳德·特朗普的看法。

sentences.en: But I think what the American people deserve to know is that he has changed his position on every conceivable issue that affects everyday Americans.
sentences.zh: 但我认为美国人民应该知道的是，他在影响美国普通人的每一个可以想象的问题上都改变了立场。

sentences.en: So they're indicative of someone who's willing to turn their back on their core values in order to amass money and power.
sentences.zh: 因此，这些信件表明他是一个为了捞取金钱和权力而愿意背弃核心价值观的人。

sentences.en: And I think that reflects a lack of integrity that isn't something that people want in their leaders.
sentences.zh: 我认为这反映了缺乏正直的品格，而这不是人们希望自己的领袖具备的品质。

sentences.en: It's one thing to evolve your opinion on certain issues when you get new information.
sentences.zh: 在获得新信息后，对某些问题改变看法是一回事。

sentences.en: It's a completely separate thing to transform your personality and change your position on every conceivable issue in order to advance your career.
sentences.zh: 为了推进自己的政治生涯而彻底改变人格、在每一个可以想象的问题上都改变立场，则是完全不同的另一回事。

sentences.en: And so it's the integrity, it's the being a political chameleon that I think people deserve to know.
sentences.zh: 所以正是这种缺乏诚信、这种政治变色龙的特质，我认为人们有权知道。

sentences.en: You have clearly concluded that J.D.
sentences.zh: 你显然已经断定JD

sentences.en: Vance's transformation was not organic.
sentences.zh: 万斯的转变不是自然而然的。

sentences.en: You see it as a story of ambition overtaking conviction.
sentences.zh: 你认为这是一个野心压倒信念的故事。

sentences.en: But I want to talk about a different possibility or I guess a different interpretation of what's happened here and arguably a more generous way of seeing what has happened to Vance.
sentences.zh: 但我想谈谈另一种可能性，或者说对这里发生的事情的另一种解释，可以说是一种更宽容的视角来看待万斯的转变。

sentences.en: And it's that people really do change and his beliefs have genuinely evolved because of changes around him, because of forces that are present now that weren't.
sentences.zh: 那就是人确实会变，他的信仰由于周围环境的变化、由于现在存在而过去不存在的力量而真正演变了。

sentences.en: And when I try to make sense of how Vance himself describes his transformation, what I hear him saying, and I wonder if you hear him saying it too, is that liberal policies,
sentences.zh: 当我试图理解万斯自己如何描述他的转变时，我听到他说的是——我想你可能也听到了——自由派政策，

sentences.en: top-down liberal approaches to issues like how to handle race, how to handle diversity, how Americans should talk about sexuality and gender,
sentences.zh: 自上而下的自由派方法来处理诸如如何对待种族、如何处理多元化、美国人应该如何谈论性和性别等问题，

sentences.en: that those have become dogmatic and that he doesn't think they've given Americans a space to think for themselves.
sentences.zh: 这些已经变得教条化，而且他认为这些并没有给美国人提供独立思考的空间。

sentences.en: And that is how he is processing these changes.
sentences.zh: 这就是他看待这些变化的方式。

sentences.en: And I wonder if you've given him the benefit of the doubt and tried to think about whether that is the explanation.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你是否曾给予他充分的信任，并试着思考这是否就是解释。

sentences.en: I don't live in J.D.
sentences.zh: 我不住在JD

sentences.en: Vance's head, so I can't definitively say what his motivations are.
sentences.zh: 万斯的脑子里，所以我无法确切地说出他的动机是什么。

sentences.en: I have certainly changed my mind about a number of things, and I hope we all evolve and change our minds.
sentences.zh: 我当然也对许多事情改变了看法，我希望我们所有人都能不断演变并改变想法。

sentences.en: It shows evolution, maturity.
sentences.zh: 这展现了演变和成熟。

sentences.en: Changing your mind with new information is a good thing.
sentences.zh: 根据新信息改变想法是一件好事。

sentences.en: But there's a difference between evolving and transforming on every conceivable issue, and again, the way you talk about people.
sentences.zh: 但演变和在每一个可以想象的问题上彻底转变之间是有区别的，再次强调，这包括你谈论人们的方式。

sentences.en: I think the content of the emails is important, but also the nature of them.
sentences.zh: 我认为邮件的内容很重要，但邮件的性质也很重要。

sentences.en: The kindness, the mutual respect is completely gone from the way he speaks publicly.
sentences.zh: 他现在公开讲话的方式中，那种善良和相互尊重已经完全消失了。

sentences.en: And both of those things are important, because the way we talk about people, especially the way our leaders talk about people, has real impact on communities.
sentences.zh: 这两点都很重要，因为我们谈论人们的方式，尤其是我们的领导人谈论人们的方式，对社区有着真实的冲击。

sentences.en: It gives everyday Americans, it emboldens them to treat their neighbors with cruelty.
sentences.zh: 它让美国普通人受到鼓舞，从而残忍地对待他们的邻居。

sentences.en: It diminishes our ability to have respectful conversations across difference.
sentences.zh: 它削弱了我们在分歧中进行互相尊重的对话的能力。

sentences.en: And so, it is very hard for me to imagine that you could transform, and again, every conceivable political issue, and also the way you talk about people different from you.
sentences.zh: 因此，我很难想象一个人会发生彻底转变，再次强调，不仅在每一个可以想象的政治问题上，而且在对待与你不同的人的谈话方式上也是如此。

sentences.en: I have a final question for you.
sentences.zh: 我有一个最后的问题要问你。

sentences.en: What would you say to J.D.
sentences.zh: 如果你觉得现在可以和JD

sentences.en: Vance if you felt you could talk to him right now?
sentences.zh: 万斯对话，你会对他说什么？

sentences.en: If you could get past everything that's just happened, and you could just the two of you sit down for a coffee or a beer?
sentences.zh: 如果你能抛开刚刚发生的一切，你们两个可以坐下来喝杯咖啡或啤酒？

sentences.en: Well, Sophia, thank you so much for your time.
sentences.zh: 好的，索菲亚，非常感谢你抽空接受采访。

sentences.en: We really appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们非常感激。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: In response to Sophia's decision to publicly share their correspondence, a spokesman for J.D.
sentences.zh: 针对索菲亚决定公开他们信件的决定，JD

sentences.en: Vance issued a statement.
sentences.zh: 万斯的一位发言人发表了一份声明。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 声明写道，

sentences.en: It's unfortunate that this individual chose to leak decades-old private conversations between friends to The New York Times.
sentences.zh: “令人遗憾的是，这个人选择将几十年前朋友之间的私人对话泄露给《纽约时报》。”

sentences.en: Senator Vance, the statement said, values his friendships with individuals across the political spectrum.
sentences.zh: 声明称，万斯参议员珍视与跨越政治谱系的人士的友谊。

sentences.en: The statement added,
sentences.zh: 声明还补充道，

sentences.en: Despite their disagreements, Senator Vance cares for Sophia and wishes Sophia the very beSt.
sentences.zh: “尽管存在分歧，万斯参议员依然关心索菲亚，并祝索菲亚一切都好。”

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他消息。

sentences.zh: 周日，副总统卡玛拉·哈里斯会见了三位潜在的竞选搭档，以测试他们之间的个人默契，

sentences.en: a sign that her search for a number two has entered its final phase.
sentences.zh: 这表明她对副手人选的搜寻已进入最后阶段。

sentences.en: Harris met with Arizona Senator Mark Kelly, Minnesota Governor Tim Walz, and Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro at her home in Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 哈里斯在华盛顿特区的家中会见了亚利桑那州参议员马克·凯利、明尼苏达州长蒂姆·沃尔兹以及宾夕法尼亚州长乔什·夏皮罗。

sentences.en: She's expected to announce her choice by tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 预计她将在明天宣布人选。

sentences.zh: 上周哈马斯和真主党的高层领导人遇刺身亡后，以色列正严阵以待，防范重大报复性袭击。

sentences.zh: 由于担心来自暗杀发生地伊朗或黎巴嫩的空袭，至少四家主要航空公司已经暂停了往返以色列的航班。

sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器在运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了许多自封的改革派。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党就陷入了一场激烈、混乱、有时甚至令人惊心动魄的争斗之中。
